timing.soundSync: No audio packed in this zip. If you add MP3s later, start them with each animation at defaultPlaybackFps.

playbackGuide: Source clips are treated as 30fps. Sheets extract every Nth frame (sampleEvery); default playbackFps ≈ 30/N so wall-clock timing matches the source (e.g. every 4 → 7.5fps). animation.sections is authoritative (role, frames, fps, loop/pingPong/reverse). Frame indices are 0-based on the exported sheet. If combat.file is set, load that .hits.json for damage boxes. Start each audioFile with its sprite animation. At the pack/sprite default playbackFps (sourceFps / sampleEvery), SFX stay aligned with the source clip. Changing fps without retiming audio will desync sound.

timing.note: Play at playbackFps to match original 30fps wall-clock timing with fewer extracted frames.
